slug: REQUIRED: same as the folder name
name: REQUIRED: human name, tooling only
title: REQUIRED: browser tab title

demos.flow: REQUIRED: a flow id, for example CoA_DTP
demos.label: REQUIRED: dropdown text

dosages: optional: the strengths the EHR's eRx form offers, for example 15 mg. Leave out for the generic 0.5, 1.0 and 2.4 mg
program.ndc: optional: the product NDC, shown on the provider's PA form. Leave out to show the drug name only
paQuestions: optional: yes or no questions for the provider's PA form, in order. Leave out to build them from the indication, or use generic ones

indication.name: optional: what the drug treats, for example Chronic spontaneous urticaria
indication.currentTreatment: optional: prefills Current Treatment Plan on the PA
indication.rationale: optional: prefills Reason for Prescribing on the PA. {drug} becomes the drug display name
